method: AST-extracted final probe functions and existing checked function; retained-output perturbations only

stable-gas-root.reason: A native mechanically stable ionic density root lies in the declared gas-density scan support.

missing-root.reason: Both native root requests did not complete.

additional-roots.reason: The native requests did not establish a single stable root.

failed-physical-solve.reason: The new physical solve is inconclusive at the declared closure and local-minimum requirements.

incomplete-scan.reason: Witness or dilution evidence is incomplete.

timeout.reason: The bounded calculation did not complete; retained partial quantities and diagnostic identify the stopping point.

nonpositive-pressure-density.reason: The new physical solve is inconclusive at the declared closure and local-minimum requirements.

nonfinite-pressure-density.reason: The new physical solve is inconclusive at the declared closure and local-minimum requirements.

sole-root-not-denser-than-liquid.reason: The sole ionic root was not established as the same root denser than the newly solved liquid; no guessed gas/liquid density cutoff is used.
